name: wan21-t2v-1.3b-l0
description: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B L0 representative at reduced spatial size with full cache and reduced frame/step counts
test_prompt: A cat sitting on a beach watching the sunset
notes: PR L0 repro for Wan2.1 T2V. Uses the same checkpoint, wan_t2v model type, T5 encoder, Wan DiT, causal 3D VAE, runner, comparator, full 256-token cache shape, and video artifact contract.
